title: Hold the Cream Cheese, Kill the Lox by Sharon Kahn
description:
Novels and Nibbles is delving into a cozy mystery where the Rabbi’s widow and amateur sleuth, Ruby Rothman, while planning a Bar Mitzvah for her dreadful twelve-year-old twin nephews, finds Herman Guenther, the man hired to make Bar Mitzvah lox spectacular, is murdered with his own slicing knife. Naturally Ruby is all in to solve this mystery that takes her from Eternal, Texas, all the way to Alaska and New Jersey uncovering secrets that reach back to Nazi-occupied Denmark.

Ya want lox? We got loxs on a toasted H&H Everything Bagel. Yep! New York Bagels! This elevated bagel with a dill and lemon cream cheese, capers, garden fresh tomatoes from our local tomato stand, smoked salmon, topped with pickled jalapenos and pickled red onions.

So much lox, so little time. Such problems everyone should have. Come by, it's only for this week!
